recipe.features: raw as-is; NO encoding for ModelTree (strings stay strings; its three data handlers infer Integer/Float-with-precision/Categorical-levels)
recipe.driver_encoding: sklearn-only ordinal encoding, fit on train (Python driver only; R and ModelTree consume raw rows)
recipe.target: last column, raw labels; binary positive class = classes[1] (canonical str-sorted order)
recipe.budget: 180s hard wall-clock cap per (algorithm x dataset) via examples/elo_budget.run_with_budget (process-group kill)

metrics.auc: binary only (classes[1] score); empty field on the board for multiclass

modeltree_baseline: 0/1 least-squares leaves; stock defaults max_depth=5 min_rows=50 minprob=0.02 split_precision=0.001 l2=0.5 prune=cp cp_alpha=5.0. Overrides limited to the leaf-family/path/winnow knobs in `settings` (exactly the examples/elo_score_python.py run_tree params). y mapped to 0.0/1.0 with positive = classes[1]; predictions = fitted values clipped to [0,1], used as P(positive). Entered on the 8 binary sets only: multiclass not entered (regression core until leaf_family #4).
field: R and Python models run stock library configs, no HPO (Optuna is a later phase); their configs live in examples/elo_score_cla_r.R and examples/elo_score_cla_python.py.
